cases.reason: The operative definitive proxy giving the October 15 redemption deadline was filed October 7, five days before protocol T0. A current deadline does not convert an old public redemption event into a prospective post-T0 event.

The redemption right/deadline was already public in September and the October 9 supplement also predates protocol T0. The protocol requires the first filing containing the operative redemption right and deadline to be accepted strictly after T0.

source_facts: Both SPACs have October 19, 2026 shareholder meetings and October 15 redemption deadlines.
Their operative redemption materials were public before October 12, 2026 21:00Z.
Protocol D selects only a first post-T0 qualifying proxy/meeting event; deadline proximity by itself is not selection eligibility.
contamination_guard: Third-party search snippets exposed approximate trust/redemption values and current market context for one or both SPACs. Those numeric snippets are contamination only and MUST NOT be used as economic evidence, spread estimates or a reason to redesign the protocol. No protocol-selected price payload was requested or used.
ordering_effect: CHAR and TVA are permanently excluded from the v1 prospective sample as pre-T0 events. Their October 15 deadline requires no economic action. Continue chronological qualification only for genuinely new post-T0 proxy/meeting filings.
next_action: Do not calculate CHAR/TVA redemption spreads. Search future/new SEC filings only for a first post-T0 SPAC event whose operative redemption right and deadline are newly public, then freeze eligibility and routes before any market price.
